title: Understanding the Problem
text: The car starts from rest and accelerates at a constant rate. We need to find out how far it travels in $$12.0\, \text{s}$$.

title: Identify the Known Values
text: Identify the values given in the problem: - Initial velocity $$(u)=0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ (since the car starts from rest)\n- Acceleration $$(a)=2.40\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$\n- Time $$(t)=12.0\, \text{s}$$

title: Choose the Right Equation
text: To find the displacement (s), use the equation of motion: $$s=ut+0.5at**{2}$$

title: Calculate the Displacement
text: Substitute the known values into the equation:\n$$s=0\cdot12+0.5\cdot2.40\cdot12**{2}$$
